label: kizuna_home_c_02
text: There is something that I would...very much like\nto ask for your help with.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_03
text: Well, you see, I do not want anyone to overhear\nthis, but...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_04
text: I hear rumors of an incredibly sweet condiment\nthat exists somewhere in the Paldea region.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_05
text: I absolutely must experience that ambrosial\nsweetness for myself.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_06
text: You are the only one who knows of my insatiable\nsweet tooth. Thus, I have no one else I can turn\r\nto for help in this matter.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_07
text: I cannot go looking for this condiment myself lest\nI destroy the image students have of me.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_08
text: I will repay you for your troubles, of course.\nGive it some thought if this piques your interest.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_09
text: In the meantime, I will gather what information I\ncan about this incredibly sweet condiment.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_10
text: I will share what I find with you as soon as I have\nmore detailed information.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_home_c_11
text: You feel trusted by Mr. Saguaro!
